text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just one step short, huh. I felt like I 
had it, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I have no choice but to admit it. My 
strategy was poorly thought out in the 
end.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Therefore, there must be room for 
improvement. I want to find a definitive 
edge that will lead us to victory.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, I'd like to hear your thoughts for 
reference. How did today's race look from 
your perspective?"
choice_data_list: So close. You ran an amazing race.

Let's polish up the rough edges!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Right? It was so close... Just a little 
bit more...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Next time. Next time, with a strategy 
that brings out the absolute best in these 
legs, I'll defeat everything in my path."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I won't make the same mistake twice. Let's 
keep moving forward, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that beyond reworking our 
strategy, we should also thoroughly hone 
her legs so she can execute it flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...You mean putting an even heavier load 
on during training?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Let's reexamine the 
training routine as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating, but... as I am now, 
there are still many areas where I fall 
short. I'll be sure to build up my 
strength before the next race."
